notes: JPN is the sole semantic and structural authority; MLG_CN/ENG are auxiliary evidence only.
Coverage is contiguous for logical unique_index 0-387; multiline CSV rows were handled by logical unique_index, never physical line number.
JPN controls and layout are preserved, including <I=RIGH>, <I=ATK>, <I=HHA>, trailing newlines, title punctuation and significant ASCII spacing.

Weapon/model identities and fixed ASCII short labels remain exactly JPN-authoritative; auxiliary normalizations/substitutions such as M37(ACM), RAILGUN for RAIL GUN, PR for MR, and publication-name substitutions were rejected.
JPN 気力回復弾 is localized as 气力恢复弹 and kept distinct from LIFE recovery terminology.
JPN publication identities such as 週刊少年マガジン, 電撃ゲームス, 電撃PlayStation®, 週刊ファミ通 and their short codes are preserved rather than replaced by auxiliary generic/Solid/Liquid labels.
Rows with source title punctuation such as 『電磁ネット。』, 『レールガン。』 and 『電磁波照射ガン。』 retain the JPN bracket/punctuation structure.
JPN-only launcher/weapon qualifiers are preserved and auxiliary-added qualifiers such as Fulton on 睡眠ガス地雷 are rejected.
Human-slingshot wordplay rows are translated conservatively and remain review-flagged.
